index.about.title: About
index.about.lead:
The world’s only major international music competition
dedicated to Taiwanese musical culture and composers.
index.about.desc: Guided by the vision of “making classical music Taiwanese, and making Taiwanese music classical,” the Competition invites a new generation of musicians from around the world to capture this island’s cultural pulse and transform it into contemporary classics for the global classical music stage.
